title: A Joomla import replaces a configuration line that ends in a comment, and stops when the copy configuration does not load
steps: Render a configuration.php whose lines carry trailing comments, a quoted ; and var; load it in PHP 7.4.
Run the load check on a file that declares $host twice.
expect: Each setting is declared once and replaced in place, comments kept; PHP loads the file.
The check refuses the doubled file naming Cannot redeclare JConfig::$host; a setting it cannot replace is refused, never appended twice.

tests: a setting line with a comment after it is replaced in place
a setting declared in a shape the renderer cannot replace
an import stops when the copy
